Article 7.1: Copy Trading (Limits and Rules)

Warren's summary

You may copy-trade a maximum of 5 FFN accounts simultaneously, regardless of account type. If you exceed 5 copy-traded accounts at any time, all copy-traded accounts will fail to be eligible for funding and must reset as a rule violation. Copy trading includes any trades entered at the same time on the same product and direction across multiple accounts, even if exits occur at different times. The 5-account copy trading limit applies across all account phases including evaluation accounts.

Maximum Accounts and Copy Trading
Rule	Limit
Evaluation accounts per user	No limit
Active Sim Funded accounts per user	5
Maximum accounts copy-traded simultaneously	5
The 5-Account Copy Trading Rule

You may copy-trade a maximum of 5 FFN accounts at any given time. This means the same trades, signals, or automated strategy may be running across no more than 5 accounts simultaneously.

EXCEEDING 5 COPY-TRADED ACCOUNTS = ALL COPY-TRADED ACCOUNTS FAIL If more than 5 accounts are being copy-traded at any time, ALL of the accounts being copy-traded will: 1. Not be eligible for funding 2. Be required to reset (considered a rule violation) This applies regardless of account type (OG or MAX).
Copy Trading Definition: Any trade taken at the same times on the ENTRY OR EXIT across multiple accounts, is considered COPIED. Meaning, if a trade is entered across more than 5 accounts at the same time, same product, same direction and then exited at different times, this is still considered a copy trade due to FFN's risk tolerance.
What Counts as Copy Trading?

Copy trading at FFN includes any situation where the same or substantially similar trades are executed across multiple accounts simultaneously. This includes:

Signal-copy services
Automated trading systems/bots running identical strategies across accounts
Manual mirror trading
Any configuration where 2 or more accounts trade identical or near-identical positions on the same product at the same time
Copy Trading and Payouts
Copy-traded accounts are subject to the same per-account payout caps.
The $10,000 per-user cap applies cumulatively across all funded accounts including copy-traded ones.
Consistency resets per account after withdrawal, not globally.

Q: Can I run 2 separate copy traders with 5 accounts each?

A: No. If two copy traders are running on the same or similar products, all accounts will be liquidated. You may run up to 5 accounts through a single copy trading strategy.

Q: Do copy trading rules apply to evaluation accounts?

A: Yes. The 5-account copy trading limit applies across all account phases.

Q: Can I run copy trading on OG and MAX accounts mixed?

A: Yes, as long as the total does not exceed 5 copy-traded accounts.
